dedupe_keys.name: faostat r package download and harmonise data from the faostat database

description: FAOSTAT is an R package that downloads statistics from FAOSTAT, the food and agriculture database of the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, and from the World Bank's World Development Indicators, and performs some harmonisation of the downloaded tables. It was first released on CRAN in 2013; version 2.4.2 was published on 1 April 2026 with Paul Rougieux as maintainer and Markus Gesmann, Filippo Gheri, Sebastian Campbell and a further author listed on CRAN, and the source is developed on GitLab. The package is written in R, needs no compilation and depends on packages such as httr, data.table and plyr; it has a reference manual and vignettes and appears in the CRAN task views for agriculture and official statistics. It is free and open source under the GNU General Public Licence, version 2 or later. Caveats: it depends on FAO's download services, whose layout has changed over time, and the harmonisation covers only some operations. Simulation uses: scripted retrieval of production, trade and food balance data to prepare inputs for food supply and trade shock models. Related records: FAOSTAT itself (data-faostat) is the source database, and the traceable food balance sheets built with gcamfaostat (data-traceable-food-balance-sheets-gcamfaostat) show another processing route.
